Sub: Norms for basic minimum number of Desktop for Field Offices and delegation of
power to Regional Commissioners to purchase Servers, Line printers and Desktops
on the basis of approved norms.

Reference: Hqr. circular No.IS-3(2)2003/Budget delegation/26085 dated 06.08.2008.
Sir,

The Headquarters has been receiving requests for providing desktop computer systems
for day to day functioning in the field offices of the organization for quite some time now.

2. While the requirement of desktops for implementing the modernization project will be
taken up in due course, it has been decided to delegate powers to the Additional Central
Commissioners (Zones, NATRSS & IS)/ Regional Provident Fund Commissioners(Grade-I), In-
charge of Regions and ZTIs to purchase and install desktops with related software in the offices
under their jurisdictions on the basis of norms that are being stipulated in the paragraphs below
to meet the minimum requirements of the day to day functioning of the field offices.

3. Furthermore, it has also been decided to delegate powers to the officers mentioned in the
paragraph above to purchase Servers and LMP on the basis of existing norms for these
equipments.

4 The norms for desktops, Servers and LMP, that are being communicated through this
circular/letter are in addition to the list of items for which financial powers have already been
delegated vide Headquarter letter cited above.

5 The norms as approved for the equipments mentioned above are as under :-
A. UNIX based servers

Field offices have been classified into three groups namely Class A, Class B and Class C
on the basis of workload of the office in terms of normalized accounts. The Servers entitlement is
based on the following criteria:

Although the servers for legacy applications are covered under the norms it has been
decided to have a temporary and partial moratorium on the exercise of powers of purchase as the
revised project is likely to be implemented in the offices very shortly in which the server
requirements would be different. Therefore, only the most urgent, unavoidable and critical
requirement of servers should be considered by the competent authorities and clearance should be
obtained from headquarters before proceeding with procurement of servers.

The desktops mentioned above include Office Productivity software (MS Office) and a
Line interactive UPS with each desktop.

6 Following general guidelines are to be followed while applying the norms as detailed

above.

All procurements should be made strictly in accordance with provisions of
General Financial Rules, 2005 as amended from time to time and other
instructions and guidelines on the subject as applicable.

A judicious view must be taken on the requirements projected by offices ensuring
that procurements are not in excess of requirements and shall not exceed the
norms in any case.

The norms are to be used by the competent authority under the delegation of
powers available to them. The revised delegation of power is being issued
separately.

The norms as above shall be applied duly taking into account the existing
Servers/Desktops/LMPs present in the respective offices and the total numbers of
systems in an office should not exceed the quantity permissible under the norms.
Policy for obsolescence of IT equipments exists and Regional Commissioner, In-
Charge of regions is empowered to purchase items declared obsolete as per the
policy.

The IS Division of Headquarters would be responsible for laying down the
specifications of the equipments and updating them from time to time keeping
in view the requirements and the changing technology environments. The field
offices would be required to make the purchases at their level on the basis of the
specification laid down by IS Division.
